package domain

import "time"

const (
	CatalogStatusNoActive = 0
	CatalogStatusActive   = 1
)

// Track is a top-level learning direction, for example Frontend Developer.
type Track struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	Order            *int
	Status           int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// TrackI18n stores localized track title/description.
type TrackI18n struct {
	TrackID     string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// CourseLevel is a reusable difficulty/stage inside tracks.
type CourseLevel struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	Status           int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// CourseLevelI18n stores localized course level title/description.
type CourseLevelI18n struct {
	LevelID     string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// CourseGroup groups related courses inside a level.
type CourseGroup struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	Status           int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// CourseGroupI18n stores localized course group title/description.
type CourseGroupI18n struct {
	GroupID     string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Description string
}

// CatalogRelationOrder identifies a child and its position under a catalog parent.
type CatalogRelationOrder struct {
	ChildID string
	Order   int
}

// CatalogScope is a public track-level path containing visible active courses.
type CatalogScope struct {
	TrackID        string `json:"track_id"`
	TrackSlug      string `json:"track_slug"`
	TrackSourceKey string `json:"track_source_key"`
	TrackTitle     string `json:"track_title"`
	TrackOrder     *int   `json:"track_order"`
	LevelID        string `json:"level_id"`
	LevelSlug      string `json:"level_slug"`
	LevelSourceKey string `json:"level_source_key"`
	LevelTitle     string `json:"level_title"`
	LevelOrder     int    `json:"level_order"`
	CourseCount    int    `json:"course_count"`
}
